races.paceDynamic: Fate's Gambit emerges as the sole committed early leader in this 13-runner handicap, with Pocket Jacks the only other prominent runner to provide early company. The majority field consists of hold-up horses (Eschweiler, Sagasti, Imnotleavinyou, Gilts, New Divide, Push Harder, Apothic Red, Love Bomb) with several unknown quantities (Moon Aura, Sancerre Rock, Cantilever), creating a bunched finish scenario. Fate's Gambit should dictate terms through steady fractions without pressure, before the large pack of closers converge in the final two furlongs on the testing soft ground. This race shape heavily favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can handle traffic and soft conditions, as the tactical setup creates a sprint finish from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Fate's Gambit sets honest pace and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The soft ground and lack of early pace pressure allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks in the final furlong. Multiple hold-up horses with the stamina to handle 7f on soft ground can exploit the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Fate's Gambit gets easy lead and soft fractions stick
scenarios.body: The prominent runner maintains energy reserves through uncontested early sections and has enough left to repel late challengers on tiring ground. Pocket Jacks could also benefit from tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Styles Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Aura, Sancerre Rock or Cantilever show different running styles than expected
scenarios.body: Horses with unclear tactical profiles position themselves prominently and benefit from the race falling apart tactically. Their fresh approach catches the predictable pace scenario off-guard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fading Finishers Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and stamina becomes irrelevant
scenarios.body: Horses marked as faders in previous runs find the soft ground and steady pace suits their stamina limitations better than expected. The crawling pace negates their usual finishing weaknesses.

watchPoints.text: Fate's Gambit could steal this if allowed completely uncontested early fractions with the large field of hold-up horses sitting too far back
Traffic problems are inevitable in the straight with 8+ hold-up horses all needing room to finish simultaneously

Moon Aura, Sancerre Rock and Cantilever have unknown running styles that could disrupt the predicted pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Pink Oxalis will likely lead uncontested with Rion Rubette, Luna Mia and Greek Flower forming the prominent pack behind. With only one natural front-runner and several prominent racers happy to sit just off the pace, this sets up for a sustainable tempo through the early stages. The soft ground will help stamina come into play over 7f, but the lack of early pace pressure means the leaders won't be stopping. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to Pink Oxalis and kick when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Oxalis gets an easy lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader will have every chance to dictate and prove hard to peg back on the testing ground. Prominent racers with tactical speed like Luna Mia or Rion Rubette can track and challenge but may find the winner has flown.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack can stalk Pink Oxalis within striking range
scenarios.body: Luna Mia or Rion Rubette can use their class advantage to reel in the leader when the pace lifts approaching the final furlong. Their ability to race handily positions them perfectly to capitalize on any faltering by Pink Oxalis.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and kicks late
scenarios.body: Greydreambeliever or Fast Tara could benefit from a sprint finish if Pink Oxalis sets pedestrian fractions. However, the soft ground and lack of early pace pressure makes this scenario less likely than usual at 7f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Solana Beach shows significant improvement from her lightly-raced profile
scenarios.body: The 3-year-old has shown promise in limited starts and gets weight relief, but needs to find substantial improvement. Greek Flower could also outrun odds if the pace sets up perfectly for her prominent style.

races.paceDynamic: Queen Aethelflaed will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure, creating a sustainable tempo through the early stages. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses and closers who can finish off what should be a modest gallop.

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole favoring horses with tactical speed. Fresh horses coming from the back can swamp the leaders in the final 100 yards.

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Beauty will control proceedings from the front with a sustainable gallop, as he's the only confirmed pace-setter in this small field. The prominent runners Rayzera will track closely, while the quartet of hold-up horses Arctic Assassin, Rapide Vega, Chapel Island and Fallacy will need the pace to collapse late. With soft going reducing the effectiveness of late kicks and only one horse setting the tempo, Son Of Beauty can dictate terms without pressure. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and capitalize on the lack of early pace pressure.

races.paceDynamic: Flying Fortress stands out as the only confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner handicap, giving him a significant tactical advantage to dictate terms from the front without pressure. With most rivals preferring prominent or hold-up tactics, the pace is likely to be honest but sustainable through the early stages, before quickening from the home turn. The lack of early pace pressure means Flying Fortress can control fractions, while the large field creates traffic problems for hold-up horses trying to find racing room in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, while making life difficult for those needing to come from the back in such a competitive field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Flying Fortress gets an uncontested lead and steady fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate a rhythm that suits his stamina patterns and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. The lack of early pace means prominent trackers like Doctor Grace and Java Wood get first run at him, but his tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly steady and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as horses like Sir Jeremy and Senna's Girl unleash strong finishes from ideal positions behind the main pace. Their class and finishing speed overwhelm the early leaders who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses pressure Flying Fortress early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely strong as horses like Booklight and Zipster refuse to let Flying Fortress dominate completely. This sets up the race for a closer with tactical speed like Tero d'Rosa or Ballymagreehan.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as several hold-up horses find their runs blocked or delayed. A handy horse like Starting Monday or Lady Arwen, positioned closer to the pace, can capitalise on the trouble behind.

watchPoints.text: Flying Fortress must be monitored for early pressure as any serious challenge to his lead completely changes the race complexion
Traffic problems in straight are almost inevitable with 18 runners - watch for hold-up horses getting blocked

Apprentice jockeys on Flying Fortress and Doctor Grace in big field could create positioning issues
Long absence horses like Booklight and Rio Doce may need the run despite showing previous ability
